name: Notify
description: Turns phone notifications on or off from your wrist — the same watch-wide setting the phone app controls. The change applies at once and reverts when the watch restarts, unless you switch on Save to watch settings. Saving needs watch software 1.4.0 exactly; on any other version the app says so on screen and changes nothing.

configFields.label: Save to watch settings
configFields.description: Off: the switch works now and reverts when the watch restarts. On: it is also written to the watch's settings file, so it lasts. The app checks the firmware first and refuses if it cannot verify it.
